nodes.question: What are the common problems associated with Ru (II) complexes in light-harvesting applications?
nodes.answer: The common problems are the limited absorption of the (MLCT) band and the expensive expenditure on Ru (II) complexes.

nodes.question: How do full-sun cocoa systems affect the age at which cocoa stops producing?
nodes.answer: Full-sun systems have been found to stop producing cocoa at a younger age compared to other systems.
